title: Environmental Economics and Policy BS
notes:
General Guidelines
- All courses taken to fulfill the major requirements below must be taken for graded credit, other than courses listed which are offered on a Pass/No Pass basis only. Other exceptions to this requirement are noted as applicable.
- A minimum cumulative grade point average (GPA) of 2.0 is required.
- A minimum GPA of 2.0 in upper division major requirements is required.
- At least 15 of the 36 required upper division units must be taken in the Rausser College of Natural Resources.
- A maximum of 16 units of independent study (courses numbered 97, 98, 99, 197, 198, and 199) may count toward graduation, with a maximum of 4 units of independent study per semester.
- No more than 1/3 of the total units attempted at UC Berkeley may be taken Pass/No Pass. This includes units in the Education Abroad Program and UC Intercampus Visitor or Exchange Programs.
- A maximum of 4 units of physical education courses will count toward graduation.
- Rausser College students may apply high school exam credit (Advanced Placement, International Baccalaureate, A-Level Exam) towards many College and Major Requirements. See AP Exam Equivalency Chart and Higher Level IB Exam Equivalency Chart in the Rausser College Student Handbook for more information.

requirements.title: Microeconomics
requirements.notes:
8 Upper Division courses are required for the Environmental Economics & Policy Major (3 Core courses + 5 Elective courses).
Of these 8 Upper Division courses, students must complete at least 5 Upper Division ENVECON courses.
These 5 Upper Division ENVECON courses may be satisfied with both Core Requirement courses and Elective Requirement courses. Courses that are cross-listed with ENVECON will also count towards this 5 Upper Division ENVECON course requirement.

requirements.title: Environmental Economics or Natural Resources Economics
Electives
requirements.notes:
Upper Division Elective Requirements: Must complete 5 elective courses. The number of ENVECON elective courses required versus non-ENVECON elective courses allowed for this requirement is directly related to the number of ENVECON versus non-ENVECON courses completed from the above Core Requirements. EEP students must complete at least 5 ENVECON courses for the entire major. Therefore;
- If you complete all 3 core requirements with ENVECON courses then you need only complete 2 ENVECON elective courses and are allowed to use 3 non-ENVECON elective courses.
- If you complete 2 core requirements with ENVECON courses then you need to complete 3 ENVECON elective courses and are allowed to use 2 non-ENVECON elective courses.
- If you complete only 1 core requirement with an ENVECON course then you need to complete 4 ENVECON elective courses and are only allowed to use 1 non-ENVECON elective course.
For a complete list of pre-approved elective courses for the EEP major please review on this page.
Remember you must complete at least 5 Upper Division ENVECON courses for the entire major. Only courses taken for 3 or more units will satisfy this requirement.
